title: 民航自動駕駛系統概念
summary: 以「從分層迴路和模式切換理解自動駕駛概念」為主線，在單軸非飛行回授與模式教學台中依序完成靜態回授與誤差、致動速率及飽和、獨立來源的加權條件、控制任務的排程期限、命令、實際與顯示的差異及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Understand autopilot concepts through layered loops and mode transitions in a Single-axis non-flying feedback and mode bench, progressing through Static feedback and error, Actuator slew and saturation, Conditions for weighting independent sources, Control-task scheduling deadlines, Command, actual and display differences, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 靜態回授與誤差：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Static feedback and error: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 靜態回授與誤差 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Static feedback and error and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「民航自動駕駛系統概念」中，本單元處理「靜態回授與誤差」。簡化單位回授的靜態誤差隨迴路增益降低，但提高增益可能使動態穩定性變差。
steps.instructionEn: Within Civil-aircraft autopilot concepts, this unit examines Static feedback and error. A simple unity-feedback static error decreases with loop gain, but increasing gain can worsen dynamic stability.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：命令r=10 units、靜態迴路增益K=4。關係式 ess=r/(1+K)；含輸出單位換算的算式 10/(1+4)，結果 2 units。適用範圍：穩定單位回授靜態模型；不代表真實自動駕駛增益可直接設定。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Command r=10 units and static loop gain K=4. Relation ess=r/(1+K); evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 10/(1+4) gives 2 units. Applicability: Stable static unity-feedback model; not an autopilot gain setting.
steps.failure: 在「靜態回授與誤差」的情境中，飽和時提高增益不會提供無限輸出，反而可能造成積分累積。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Static feedback and error, During saturation, more gain cannot produce unlimited output and may contribute to windup.
steps.check: 針對「靜態回授與誤差」，把延遲、致動限制和感測雜訊分開列，說明靜態模型缺少哪些項。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Static feedback and error, List delay, actuator limits and sensor noise separately to identify missing dynamics. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 K 改為9，其餘條件固定。用 10/(1+9) 重算，結果從 2 變成 1 units。先預測方向，再記下對「靜態回授與誤差」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only K to 9, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 10/(1+9): 2 becomes 1 units. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Static feedback and error, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「民航自動駕駛系統概念」的「靜態回授與誤差：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「座艙模擬器：回應之前」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Static feedback and error: Mechanism and observation” in “Civil-aircraft autopilot concepts”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Cockpit Simulator: Before the Response” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
